moe: 95% margins, worked out as in the Work report's Table 8: 1.96 × √(p(1 − p) / n) on the unweighted n. They leave out the effect of weighting, so true margins are somewhat wider; the MCP doesn't serve its own yet (#273). States rest on {nLo} to {nHi} respondents each, an age group within a state on as few as {cellMin}. Groups under 100 are starred: interpret with caution.

set_text.title: Feeling thermometers in every state
set_text.subtitle: Share of adults who rate each above 50 on a feeling thermometer that runs from 0 to 100
set_text.note: Wave 39 from the survey team's cleaned release of Nov. 3, 2026, which may still change before the final file. Not for publication. Above 50 means 51 to 100: a rating of exactly 50, the scale's midpoint, is not counted. Every adult was shown each thermometer; those who skipped one (2.6% to 7.1% nationally, up to 17% in a state) are left out of its share.
